name: charon-clipboard
title: Charon Clipboard
description: A Clipy-style clipboard manager: press a hotkey and pick from your clipboard history and snippets in a menu right at your cursor.
author: unz47

commands.name: popup-main
commands.title: Show Clipboard Menu
commands.subtitle: Charon
commands.description: Show history and snippets in a menu at the mouse cursor. Clipy's hotkey: ⌘⇧V.

commands.name: popup-history
commands.title: Show History Menu
commands.subtitle: Charon
commands.description: Show clipboard history in a menu at the mouse cursor. Clipy's hotkey: ⌃⌘V.

commands.name: popup-snippets
commands.title: Show Snippet Menu
commands.subtitle: Charon
commands.description: Show snippets in a menu at the mouse cursor. Clipy's hotkey: ⌘⇧B.

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Clipboard Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Charon
commands.description: The same menu in the menu bar.

commands.name: manage-snippets
commands.title: Edit Snippets
commands.subtitle: Charon
commands.description: Add, edit, reorder and delete snippets, and import or export Clipy XML.

commands.name: clipboard-helper
commands.title: Clipboard Helper
commands.subtitle: Charon
commands.description: Enable or disable the background helper that records copies and shows the menu.

preferences.name: maxHistory
preferences.title: Maximum History Size
preferences.description: How many clipboard items to keep.

preferences.name: reorder
preferences.title: Reorder
preferences.label: Move pasted items to the top
preferences.description: Move an item to the top of the history after you paste it.

preferences.name: dedupe
preferences.title: Duplicates
preferences.label: Remove duplicates
preferences.description: Copying the same content again moves it to the top instead of adding a duplicate.

preferences.name: pasteAfterSelect
preferences.title: Paste
preferences.label: Paste after selecting an item
preferences.description: When disabled, the item is only copied to the clipboard (Clipy's "Input ⌘+V after menu item selection").

preferences.name: itemsInline
preferences.title: Inline Items
preferences.description: Number of items shown directly in the menu before the numbered folders.

preferences.name: itemsPerFolder
preferences.title: Items per Folder
preferences.description: Number of items in each history folder (1 - 10, 11 - 20, ...).

preferences.name: maxTitleLength
preferences.title: Maximum Title Length
preferences.description: Longer menu titles are truncated with an ellipsis.

preferences.name: numericShortcuts
preferences.title: Number Keys
preferences.label: Select items with the 1-9 and 0 keys
preferences.description: Add numeric key equivalents to history items in the popup menu.

preferences.name: tooltip
preferences.title: Tooltips
preferences.label: Show the full text as a tooltip
preferences.description: Show up to 200 characters when hovering over an item.

preferences.name: colorPreview
preferences.title: Color Preview
preferences.label: Show a swatch for color codes
preferences.description: Show a color swatch for items like #FF8800.

preferences.name: confirmClear
preferences.title: Clear Confirmation
preferences.label: Ask before clearing the history
preferences.description: Show a confirmation dialog before clearing the history.

preferences.name: storeRich
preferences.title: Rich Text
preferences.label: Keep formatting (HTML and RTF)
preferences.description: When disabled, only plain text is stored.

preferences.name: storeImage
preferences.title: Images
preferences.label: Store images
preferences.description: Store copied images as PNG files.

preferences.name: storeFile
preferences.title: Files
preferences.label: Store files copied in Finder
preferences.description: When disabled, copied files are stored as their file names.

preferences.name: excludedApps
preferences.title: Excluded Apps
preferences.description: Comma-separated app names or bundle IDs whose copies are never recorded (for example: 1Password, com.apple.keychainaccess).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
